```{ojs}
//| output: false
dados = await FileAttachment("./data/dados.tsv").tsv({ typed: true })

igv = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/igv@3.0.2/dist/igv.esm.min.js").then(m => m.default)

```

```{r}

list.files("./results/altss/", pattern="\\.tsv")

```

## {.toolbar}
    
```{ojs}
viewof species = Inputs.select(dados, {label: "Species", format: x => x.Filenames, value: dados[0]})
```

## Row {height=60%}

### Column {width="35%"}

```{ojs}
fn = species["Filenames"]
sp = species["Species"]

results = await FileAttachment(`./results/altss/hsalinarum-alTSS.tsv`).tsv({ typed: true })

viewof linha_selecionada = Inputs.table(results, { 
  multiple: false, 
  columns: ["Chromossome", "Position", "Strand", "TSSCount"],
  header: {
    "Chromossome": "NC",
    "Position": "Pos",
    "Strand": "Strand",
    "TSSCount": "n(TSS)"
  },
  width: {
    "Chromossome": 100,
    "Position": 100,
    "Strand": 50,
    "TSSCount": 100
  }
})
```

## Row {height=70%}

```{=html}
<div id="igv-container" style="height: 100%; width: 100%; padding: 5px;"></div>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
igvbrowser = {
  const container = document.querySelector("#igv-container");
  const options = {
    reference: {
      id: `${fn}`,
      name: `${sp}`,
      fastaURL: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.fna`,
      indexURL: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.fna.fai`
    },
    tracks: [
      {
        name: "Anotação",
        type: "annotation",
        format: "gff3", 
        url: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.gff`,
        searchable: true
      }
    ]
  };
  
  igv.removeAllBrowsers();
  
  return igv.createBrowser(container, options);
}
```
